name: Edge-IIoTset: Industrial IoT Cybersecurity Dataset
description: Edge-IIoTset is a comprehensive cybersecurity dataset designed specifically for Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) edge computing architectures, developed by the IEEE Internet of Things laboratory. Deployed on a physical multi-tier testbed comprising 10+ types of IoT devices (water quality, temperature, flame, sound, soil moisture sensors), edge computing gateways, and cloud servers, it incorporates 14 distinct attack types grouped into 5 categories: DoS/DDoS, Information Gathering, Man-in-the-Middle, Injection, and Malware/Ransomware. Features 61 extracted flow and protocol features across Modbus, MQTT, HTTP, and TCP/IP telemetry.

license.name: IEEE Open Data / Academic Non-Commercial Terms

verification.notes: Verified 20.95M sensor and telemetry flow records, 14 attack types across Modbus/MQTT/HTTP, and IEEE terms.

citation.paper_title: Edge-IIoTset: A New Comprehensive Realistic Cyber Security Dataset of IoT and IIoT Applications for Centralized and Federated Learning
